On technology mix, Trane sees data-center demand weighted TOWARD AIR-COOLED chillers and, importantly, toward CLOSED-LOOP systems with less evaporative cooling — management pushing back on the 'data centers waste water' narrative. Historical rule of thumb has inverted: water-cooled used to signal a 40-year data center and air-cooled a 20-year one, but that shifted given capacity requirements, and modern air-cooled technology now reaches efficiencies similar to or better than water-cooled. Trane is also 'helping many of our hyperscalers and our big colos design' systems for the DIRECT CURRENT versus alternating current transition.
